newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-LIMOGES RESTORE PRIDE WITH FIRST VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-LIMOGES RESTORE PRIDE WITH FIRST VICTORY.

text.p: Former European champions CSP Limoges of France restored their pride on Thursday when they clinched a first hard-fought win 84-80 over Ulkerspor Istanbul in a group A EuroLeague basketball match. After three losses in a row including an opening home defeat against Maccabi Tel Aviv and another one against impressive newcomers Milan, Limoges needed to win on Thursday to stay in realistic contention for the next phase.

Inspired by their stylish playmaker Yann Bonato, the top scorer of the match with 26 points, Limoges made a fine start to lead by 10 points (31-21) after 12 minutes and reach the break well ahead (54-41).
Some French clumsiness helped Istanbul to close the gap and level the score 77-77 with one minute to go.
But Limoges reacted swiftly and settled the issue with a two-pointer from American Gerald Glass in the last 30 seconds.
